name: SeAH Besteel Holdings Corporation
summary: SeAH Besteel Holdings Corporation manufactures and sells special steel products in South Korea, the rest of Asia, South America, North America, Oceania, Europe, and internationally. It operates through Special Steel and Aluminum Extrusion divisions. The company offers special steel products comprising rolled materials, forgings, and secondary processed materials; open-die forging products consisting of shells, rings, shafts, hollow bars, rolls, discs, blocks, and mold steel, as well as forgings for ship engines; nuclear power materials and equipment, such as casks, canisters, and nuclear forgings; and automotive parts, undercarriage parts, and machinery parts.
